title: San Antonio River Walk
specs: The River Walk is 15 miles long and flows through approximately five miles of downtown San Antonio
The Downtown and Museum Reach portions are open 24 hours a day
Mission Reach offers a quieter outdoor experience with trails and natural landscapes
Children 2 years or older need a ticket for Day of the Dead River Parade
The River Walk is a public park open to all visitors

blurb: The San Antonio River Walk is a 15-mile long public park flowing through downtown San Antonio. Visitors can stroll along the river, take narrated boat tours, dine at riverside restaurants, browse shops, visit museums and historic attractions, and attend seasonal events. The River Walk includes Downtown, Museum Reach, and Mission Reach sections, each offering different experiences from vibrant nightlife to quiet nature trails.
